concerns.text: FR-006 introduces permutation‑based false‑positive‑rate (FPR) estimation. The original idea never mentioned estimating FPR; this adds a new research question beyond quantifying cleaning‑induced shifts in p‑values, CIs, and effect sizes.
FR-007 applies Holm‑Bonferroni correction across all cleaning‑variant p‑values. The idea did not request any multiple‑comparison correction, so this expands the scope without justification.

FR-020 generates synthetic benchmark datasets (null‑effect and non‑null effect) to assess bias. The idea limits analysis to real public datasets; synthetic benchmarks constitute an unrequested extension.

FR-021 conducts a paired Wilcoxon signed‑rank test on `p_value_delta`. The original research question did not specify hypothesis‑testing of delta metrics, making this an additional analysis not required by the idea.
